name: Joplin Server
description: Sync server for Joplin notes (desktop and mobile note-taking app).
notes: First sign-in: admin@localhost / admin. Change it right away.
compose:
services:
  db:
    image: postgres:16
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${SECRET}
      - POSTGRES_USER=joplin
      - POSTGRES_DB=joplin
    volumes:
      - ./db:/var/lib/postgresql/data
  app:
    image: joplin/server:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on: [db]
    ports:
      - "22300:22300"
    environment:
      - APP_PORT=22300
      - APP_BASE_URL=http://${HOST}:22300
      - DB_CLIENT=pg
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${SECRET}
      - POSTGRES_DATABASE=joplin
      - POSTGRES_USER=joplin
      - POSTGRES_PORT=5432
      - POSTGRES_HOST=db
